The main components are: 1) GPS Module - provides real-time location data by receiving signals from satellites. 2) RFID Tag - uniquely identifies the vehicle and can be used for authentication and tracking. 3) Communication Module - transmits data from the GPS and RFID components to a central server. 4) Data Storage Unit - stores the collected data for later retrieval. 5) User Interface - allows users to access tracking information through a mobile app or web portal.

Security features include: 1) Data Encryption - protects data transmitted between components and the central server. 2) Authentication - ensures only authorized users can access the system. 3) Tamper Detection - identifies unauthorized physical or digital interference. 4) Geofencing - alerts users if the vehicle moves outside a predefined area. 5) Remote Disablement - allows for deactivation of the vehicle’s systems in case of theft.
